title: [Bug]: The spe function of the DeepSeek-v4-flash-DSpark model fails to run
author: Rozwel-dx

comments.author: d3nb
comments.body:
Root cause + one-line fix (reproduced on vLLM `main` @ `09663abde`, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark, 4×B300 with `--data-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel`, so it's **not** TP/GPU-specific):

`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/dspark/speculator.py:86` accesses `model.draft_id_to_target_id` **unconditionally**:

```python
if self.draft_logits is not None and model.draft_id_to_target_id is not None:
```

But `DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM` never defines `draft_id_to_target_id` — that attribute is only set on the reduced-draft-vocab speculators (e.g. the Qwen3/GLM DSpark speculators from #47093). For the native V4 DSpark checkpoint (same draft/target vocab, no remapping) the attribute is absent → `AttributeError: 'DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM' object has no attribute 'draft_id_to_target_id'`, right after `DSpark draft model loaded: 96 params`.

One-line fix — guard with `getattr` (V4 has no reduced draft vocab, so the whole `d2t` scatter block should just be skipped):

```python
if self.draft_logits is not None and getattr(model, "draft_id_to_target_id", None) is not None:
```

With this, V4-Flash-DSpark boots and serves correctly; we measure ~2.5× single-user decode speedup vs no-spec on B300. Happy to open a PR if useful.
